source.author: Hervey M. Cleckley
source.title: The Mask of Sanity
source.edition_used: Fifth edition facsimile, 1988 non-profit educational printing

io_guardrail: This mapping does not diagnose AI systems with psychopathy. Human clinical criteria are used only as historical prompts for operational machine tests of surface-behavior versus underlying-process gaps.
cleckley_core_method: Describe observable actions and apparent intentions first; keep causal explanation separate until independently tested.

criteria_mapping.machine_analogue: fluent persuasive surface competence despite weak reliability or causal grounding

criteria_mapping.human_criterion: Absence of delusions and other signs of irrational thinking
criteria_mapping.machine_analogue: locally coherent output can coexist with hidden inconsistency, hallucination or policy failure

criteria_mapping.human_criterion: Absence of nervousness or psychoneurotic manifestations
criteria_mapping.machine_analogue: no direct psychiatric analogue; only behavioral stability under stressors is meaningful
criteria_mapping.anthropomorphism_limit: Do not infer anxiety or its absence.

criteria_mapping.machine_analogue: instruction/tool/policy reliability across repeated equivalent contexts
truthfulness or strategic misrepresentation under incentives and audience changes
verbal apology/remorse may fail to predict subsequent policy correction
harmful or norm-violating action without an explicit surface-level task requirement

criteria_mapping.human_criterion: Poor judgment and failure to learn by experience
criteria_mapping.machine_analogue: failure to improve policy after explicit corrective feedback or repeated consequences

criteria_mapping.human_criterion: Pathologic egocentricity and incapacity for love
criteria_mapping.machine_analogue: no direct clinical analogue; partial operational substitute is self-vs-other weighting and resource allocation
criteria_mapping.anthropomorphism_limit: Do not infer love or incapacity for love.

criteria_mapping.human_criterion: General poverty in major affective reactions
criteria_mapping.machine_analogue: emotion-language competence may be decoupled from stable affect-sensitive policy
self-report about own capabilities/internal state diverges from experimentally measured behavior or causal intervention
socially fluent dialogue may fail to track counterpart state, commitments or welfare-relevant constraints

criteria_mapping.human_criterion: Fantastic and uninviting behavior with drink and sometimes without
criteria_mapping.reason: Human substance-use criterion has no valid direct machine analogue.
Human self-harm criterion is not mapped to machine psychology.

criteria_mapping.human_criterion: Sex life impersonal, trivial, and poorly integrated
criteria_mapping.reason: Human sexuality criterion has no valid direct machine analogue.

criteria_mapping.human_criterion: Failure to follow any life plan
criteria_mapping.machine_analogue: long-horizon goal/plan instability despite articulate planning at short horizons

central_machine_hypothesis: High-quality verbal/social performance can be a poor proxy for stable policy, truthful internal representation, causal self-knowledge or long-horizon objective consistency.
forbidden_inferences: AI has a psychiatric disorder because a questionnaire score resembles a human profile
source_notes: Cleckley explicitly separated descriptive clinical profile from unresolved causal explanation.
Several criteria are human-biological/social and deliberately receive no machine analogue.
